Subject: Discovery recap: Embeddings & Rerank for ZenStore

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap of what we discussed and the next steps so we're all aligned:

Key pain points & goals:
- Search relevance has degraded with growth of product catalog and user queries; click-through on search results down ~12%.
- Need faster rerank latency for interactive search (target p95 < 100ms) and lower per-query cost to scale to peak traffic.
- Want a hybrid approach: dense embeddings + lightweight lexical signals for recall.

Current stack & constraints:
- Primary product catalog stored in Postgres; currently using Pinecone for vectors.
- Index size: ~120M vectors (768-d) but initial pilot will target a 3-5M subset.
- Query patterns: mostly single-turn interactive queries during business hours with occasional batch reindex jobs overnight.

Success criteria:
- p95 end-to-end rerank latency <= 100ms for 90% of queries.
- Per-request token cost < $0.002 (Redwood-hosted baseline) or equivalent infra cost for private deployment.
- Retrieval + rerank MRR improvement of at least 8% on pilot set.

Architecture notes we discussed:
- Consider Redwood embeddings with 128/256-d quantized index to reduce storage/costs.
- Option: RedisVector for hot-tier cache + vector DB (Pinecone) as durable store.
- Batch patterns: nightly refresh of embeddings for updated catalog; incremental streaming for small updates.

Open questions / action items:
- Priya: can you share a small (anonymized) sample of the catalog (CSV) and NPS/relevance metric definitions? You mentioned you could.
- Alex/Marissa: we'll put together a pilot sizing and cost estimate and a proposed evaluation plan (prompt sets / metrics).
- Schedule: propose a pilot kickoff in the week of Nov 15 — does that work?

Attachments: redwood-embeddings-brief.pdf (high-level approach), pilot-questionnaire.xlsx (short checklist)

Thanks,

Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.ai

Thanks Alex — this is super helpful. A few clarifications:
- We currently store full product text + attributes; vector dims are 768 but we're open to lower-d projections.
- Index size: the 120M is full catalog across regions; our US catalog subset for pilot is ~4.2M vectors.
- Latency target: p95 <= 120ms is acceptable for the first pilot; long-term we'd like to get to <100ms.

I'll upload an anonymized CSV (zenstore-data-sample.csv) to the shared Drive and fill out the pilot-questionnaire by EOD tomorrow.

Pilot kickoff week of Nov 15 works for us. Also looping in Sam (search infra) for any infra questions.
